cues.en: They take everything we had. And not just from us, from our fathers and from our father's fathers. And from our father's father's fathers. Yeah. And from our father's father's father's father's. You understand? Don't labor the point. And what have they ever given us in return?
cues.zh: 他们拿走了我们拥有的一切。不只是从我们这儿，还从我们父辈、我们父辈的父辈那里。还有我们父辈的父辈的父辈。对。还有我们父辈的父辈的父辈的父辈。你明白吗？别老揪着这点不放。那他们到底给过我们什么回报？
